description: Wateroverlast - Gemiddeld Hoogste Grondwaterstanden huidig (2017) is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.zuid-holland.nl. This map shows the GHG results for current climate; full of the Average Highest Groundwater Levels (GHG) of the National Water Model (results September 2017). The groundwater levels have been finely visualised with the Current Height Stock Netherlands, version 3 (AHN3). Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Flooding – Average Highest Groundwater Levels Current (2017)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include GHG, Wateroverlast, Klimaateffectatlas. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2017-09-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
